shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" | head -100

echo "--- react version ---" && cat node_modules/react/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo "--- next version ---" && cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"' && echo "--- ViewTransition export? ---" && node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/[Vv]iew|unstable|experimental|addTransitionType/.test(k)))" 2>&1 | head -20

echo "--- next's bundled react channel ---" && ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo "--- does next have viewTransition config? ---" && grep -ro "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -5 && echo "--- next Link linkBoundary/onNavigate ---" && grep -rlo "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/*.js 2>/dev/null | head

echo "--- ViewTransition in next's react-experimental ---" && grep -ro "unstable_ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/*.js | sort -u | head -3 && echo "--- addTransitionType ---" && grep -ro "unstable_addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/*.js | sort -u | head -3 && echo "=== viewTransition in next config types ===" && grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -10
echo "=== viewTransition across next dist ===" && grep -rlo "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/ | head && echo "=== ViewTransition case-insensitive in react-experimental ===" && grep -roi "viewtransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/ | sed 's/.*://' | sort -u | head

echo "=== experimental flags list in config schema ===" && grep -o "viewTransition[A-Za-z]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | sort -u | head && echo "=== search whole next for 'experimental.viewTransition' ===" && grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head

echo "=== where in react-experimental ===" && grep -rli "viewtransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/ | head && echo "=== config-schema experimental keys sample ===" && grep -o "'[a-zA-Z]*[Tt]ransition[a-zA-Z]*'" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | sort -u | head
echo "=== next config-shared.d.ts: transition-ish experimental flags ===" && grep -n "ransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20

echo "=== stable compiled react: ViewTransition ===" && grep -o "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | sort -u | head && echo "=== exports in stable compiled react ===" && node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js')).filter(k=>/iew|ransitionType/i.test(k)))"
echo "=== exports in experimental compiled react ==="
node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.production.js')).filter(k=>/iew|ransitionType/i.test(k)))"

echo "=== @types/react version ===" && grep '"version"' node_modules/@types/react/package.json && echo "=== ViewTransition in @types/react ===" && grep -rn "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head

echo "=== does next alias react to compiled? ===" && grep -rn "compiled/react'" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "--- createRSCAliases / getReactAliases ---"; grep -rno "compiled/react\b[^-]" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -8

head -40 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && echo "=== ViewTransition declaration + addTransitionType ===" && grep -n "export const ViewTransition\|export function addTransitionType\|declare module" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head

echo "=== Link props: onNavigate ===" && grep -n "onNavigate" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- link.js onNavigate impl ---"; grep -rn "onNavigate" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo "=== startTransition around navigate in link.js ===" && grep -n "startTransition\|dispatchNavigateAction\|React.startTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== transitionTypes in link.d.ts ===" && grep -n -B8 "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head -40
sed -n '45,95p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js

grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigator.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== popstate / back-forward transition types ==="; grep -rno "transitionTypes[^,;)]*" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -rln "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client/ 2>/dev/null | head -10
grep -n -B6 -A10 "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/sequential-router-queue.js | head -50

echo "=== react-server build exports ===" && node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.react-server.production.js')).filter(k=>/iew|ransition/i.test(k)))" && echo "=== stable react-server ===" && node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.production.js')).filter(k=>/iew|ransition/i.test(k)))"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; echo "=== tsc exit: $? ==="
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== / status ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/; echo "=== detail status ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -2

echo "=== detail page HTML (body) ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' | head -c 1200; echo; echo "=== server log errors ==="; grep -i "error\|warn\|fail" /tmp/next.log | head -10; echo "(none above = clean)"
curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -A2 -B2 'product-hero\|back-link\|product-detail\|<main' | head -40
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -o 'vt-name="[^"]*"[^>]*' | head -8

echo "=== React's handling of 'none' view-transition class ===" && grep -o "'none'\|\"none\"" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js | head -3; echo "--- context around none in VT code ---"; grep -o "........................................none'.........................." node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js | head -6
grep -o '.\{130\}"none".\{90\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js | grep -i "viewTransition\|vt-\|Name" | head -5
grep -o '.\{200\}"none".\{150\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -8
grep -on "applyViewTransitionName\|viewTransitionName =\|'none' ===\|=== 'none'\|\"none\" ===\|=== \"none\"" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -20
sed -n '16425,16450p;16945,16965p' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js
grep -n -B3 -A6 'props.enter\|props.exit\|props.share' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | grep -A6 -B3 "getViewTransitionClassName" | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -5; echo "tsc: $?"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "Compiled|error|Error|warn|✓|Failed" | head -15

CSS=$(ls .next/static/chunks/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "file: $CSS"; echo "=== keyframes referenced vs defined ==="; grep -o "animation:[[:space:]]*vt-[a-z-]*" "$CSS" | sed 's/.*vt-/vt-/' | sort -u > /tmp/used.txt; grep -o "@keyframes vt-[a-z-]*" "$CSS" | sed 's/@keyframes //' | sort -u > /tmp/def.txt; echo "-- referenced:"; cat /tmp/used.txt; echo "-- defined:"; cat /tmp/def.txt; echo "-- referenced but NOT defined (should be empty):"; comm -23 /tmp/used.txt /tmp/def.txt

CSS=$(ls .next/static/chunks/*.css | head -1)
echo "=== VT classes referenced in CSS ==="
grep -o "::view-transition-[a-z-]*(\.[a-z-]*)" "$CSS" | sed 's/.*(\.//;s/)//' | sort -u > /tmp/css_cls.txt
cat /tmp/css_cls.txt
echo "=== VT classes used in JSX (share/enter/exit/update values) ==="
grep -rhoE "'(page-(enter|exit)-(forward|back)|page-fade-(in|out)|product-image-morph|suspense-reveal)'" app/ | tr -d "'" | sort -u > /tmp/jsx_cls.txt
grep -rhoE '"(product-image-morph|suspense-reveal)"' app/ | tr -d '"' | sort -u >> /tmp/jsx_cls.txt
sort -u /tmp/jsx_cls.txt -o /tmp/jsx_cls.txt
cat /tmp/jsx_cls.txt
echo "=== in JSX but no CSS rule (should be empty) ==="; comm -23 /tmp/jsx_cls.txt /tmp/css_cls.txt
echo "=== in CSS but unused in JSX (should be empty) ==="; comm -13 /tmp/jsx_cls.txt /tmp/css_cls.txt
echo "=== universal group selector survived minification ==="; grep -c "view-transition-group(\*)" "$CSS"

CSS=$(ls .next/static/chunks/*.css | head -1)
echo "=== media queries in built CSS ==="; grep -o "@media[^{]*" "$CSS" | sort -u
echo "=== skeleton animation disabled under reduce? ==="; grep -o "prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[^@]*" "$CSS" | head -c 700

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; (npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 7
for u in "/" "/product/classic-sneakers" "/product/cotton-hoodie" "/product/does-not-exist"; do
  printf "%-32s -> %s\n" "$u" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3112$u)"
done
echo "=== server errors ==="; grep -iE "error|exception|failed" /tmp/next2.log | head; echo "(clean if empty)"

(npx next start -p 3113 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &); sleep 8
for u in "/" "/product/classic-sneakers" "/product/cotton-hoodie" "/product/does-not-exist"; do
  printf "%-32s -> %s\n" "$u" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3113$u)"
done
echo "=== server errors ==="; grep -iE "error|exception|failed" /tmp/next3.log | head -5; echo "(clean if nothing above)"
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
git status --short && echo "=== diffstat ===" && git diff --stat
echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== package.json diff (pre-existing) ==="; git diff package.json; echo "=== .gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff now ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "Compiled|error|Error|Failed|✓ Gen|reconfigured" | head -10; echo "=== final tsc ==="; npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc clean"
rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
